dataset.name: Providence FFPE breast cancer recurrence cohort (2012)
dataset.description: Primary breast cancer FFPE tumors with public whole-transcriptome RNA-seq counts and exact individual follow-up for a recurrence and breast-cancer-death composite endpoint.
dataset.cohort_context: The source publication reports 136 archival primary breast cancer tumors from Providence St. Joseph Medical Center. All 136 specimens with adequate remaining RNA were sequenced. The cohort includes node-negative and node-positive disease and mixed adjuvant treatment; patient-level stage, age, treatment and receptor covariates are not released with the endpoint table.

metadata.source_program: Providence St. Joseph Medical Center archival breast cancer cohort
metadata.library_method: ScriptSeq whole-transcriptome libraries from FFPE tumor RNA; single-read Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing
metadata.independence_note: The publication identifies a Providence St. Joseph Medical Center archival cohort used before the TCGA era. Its anonymous Sample_1 through Sample_136 identifiers, institutional provenance and assay release are distinct from TCGA and from every BRCA cohort already registered in TRACE.
metadata.curation_note: The release contains one primary-tumor profile and one positive follow-up interval per patient. Expression and clinical identifiers match exactly. The source event is a composite of first breast cancer recurrence, breast-cancer death or death from unknown cause and is not relabelled as a pure recurrence endpoint.

samples.sample_role: Primary FFPE tumor used for whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing

expression.label: Dryad counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Exact HUGO symbol validation through the cBioPortal gene service
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The two case-insensitively duplicated source symbols are excluded rather than guessed or aggregated.
expression.scale_note: TRACE computes library sizes across all 21,285 source RefSeq gene rows for each sample, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). Symbols not recognized by the exact current HUGO mapping are retained in source evidence but excluded from the analysis layer.

endpoints.label: Breast cancer recurrence/death composite
endpoints.time_origin: Source clinical follow-up origin; the public RNA-seq release does not further specify the calendar origin
endpoints.event_definition: First breast cancer recurrence, death due to breast cancer, or death due to unknown cause
